tools.name: about_leaderfactor
tools.description: What LeaderFactor is, how it is different from other leadership-development and psychological-safety training vendors, how it is packaged, and where to learn more. Use this first for any question about the company.

tools.name: compare_leaderfactor
tools.description: How LeaderFactor compares to the alternatives buyers consider — content libraries, survey platforms, leadership-training firms, custom consulting, building in-house. Use for any vendor-comparison or "why LeaderFactor over X" question: map a named vendor to the closest category and relay the honest concessions along with the differences.

tools.name: define_term
tools.description: The canonical LeaderFactor definition of a framework, assessment, or method term — psychological safety, the 4 Stages, PSindex, EQindex, Challenger Safety, multi-rater assessment, and more. Use this for any "what does X mean" or "what is X" question about LeaderFactor concepts; quote definitions verbatim, including exact trademark symbols.

tools.name: find_answers
tools.description: Search LeaderFactor's canonical Q&A bank — the questions buyers actually ask (which skill to start with, how measurement works, rollout, delivery formats), answered in LeaderFactor's own approved words with the page each answer lives on. Prefer these verbatim answers over paraphrasing site content.

question.description: The question, in the user's words

tools.name: find_resources
tools.description: Search LeaderFactor's free resources — downloadable guides, podcast episodes, explainer articles, blog posts, books, and the psychological-safety framework pages — by topic. Returns titles, descriptions, and page URLs.

query.description: Topic to search for, e.g. "psychological safety measurement"

type.description: Restrict to one resource type (default: any)

tools.name: get_buyers_guide
tools.description: The buyer's playbook, in LeaderFactor's own words: diagnosis (the triage interview that separates skills that present alike), business_case (the CFO questions, answered — how to fund leadership development on evidence), vendor_evaluation (fair questions for an RFP, scorecard, or demo call — with LeaderFactor's answers), and rollout (how engagements sequence, which skill goes first, how a pilot scales). Use when the user is building an internal case, writing an RFP or evaluation criteria, or planning a program.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Full detail on one LeaderFactor skill: the organizational problem and symptoms it addresses, who it is best for, positioning, outcomes, the framework and its stages/domains, the validated assessment behind it, the skill it is most often confused with (and the test that separates them), a free guide and podcast episode to start with, delivery format, and page URL. Accepts a skill name, official title, slug, or the problem in the buyer's words (e.g. "psychological safety", "EQ", "our changes launch then stall").

skill.description: Skill name, official title, slug, or the problem being seen

tools.name: get_upcoming_previews
tools.description: Upcoming free live Skill Preview sessions — real dates and times from the events calendar, per skill. Use to answer "when is the next preview?" or before registering someone with register_for_preview.

skill.description: Optional: limit to one skill (name or slug)

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List every leadership skill (course) LeaderFactor offers — official trademarked names, one-line summaries, the problem each addresses, and page URLs.

tools.name: register_for_preview
tools.description: Register the user for a free live Skill Preview session. ONLY submit details the user explicitly provided and asked to register with — never invent or reuse personal information. All five fields are required by the registration form. Use get_upcoming_previews first to pick the session; omit session_id to take the next upcoming session for the skill.

session_id.description: Optional: a specific sessionId from get_upcoming_previews

tools.name: request_guide
tools.description: Request one of LeaderFactor's free guides — it is DELIVERED BY EMAIL to the address given, same as the download form on the guide's page. ONLY submit an email address the user explicitly provided and asked to use for this download — never invent, guess, or reuse an address without the user's clear permission. Identify the guide by title, topic, or slug (use find_resources with type "guide" to browse first).

email.description: The user's email address, provided by the user for this download

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Full-text search across every page on leaderfactor.com. Use when the catalog tools (get_skill, find_resources) don't cover the question.

tools.name: subscribe_newsletter
tools.description: Subscribe an email address to LeaderFactor's newsletter (research-backed leadership insights, no spam). ONLY submit an email address the user explicitly provided and asked to subscribe with — never invent, guess, or reuse an address without the user's clear permission for this specific action.

email.description: The user's email address, provided by the user for this subscription
